title: One Hit KO
description: You can now kill another player with just one hit from any weapon. Great for PvP and Minigames!
body:
With this installed, players can kill each other with one hit with any weapon, by default.

Can be configured to require more than one hit. You can choose how many. It will replace health damage with number of hits!

Doesn't affect health damage mechanics by mobs.

Only required to be installed on server, if single player LAN, only the host needs to have it installed.
